purpose: A compact user, project, or account identity with a primary name and optional supporting detail.
behaviorProvider: Shared data-grid cell adapter; table/record state remains with its host.

component: Render the entity name and optional detail as text. Use an Avatar for user entities, a decorative folder for projects and a decorative globe for accounts unless avatar is supplied.
Forward div attributes and className without adding navigation, selection or row activation.
host: Supply the correct entity type and accessible custom avatar content.
Own navigation and permissions in a separate actual link/button or table interaction.

requirements.statement: Render the entity name and optional detail as text. Use an Avatar for user entities, a decorative folder for projects and a decorative globe for accounts unless avatar is supplied.
Forward div attributes and className without adding navigation, selection or row activation.
Supply the correct entity type and accessible custom avatar content.
Own navigation and permissions in a separate actual link/button or table interaction.

Use data-display group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: EntityCell is descriptive content, not a clickable row or identity resolver.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
